rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account, then reviewed the user’s orders via read-only tools. It identified the correct delivered order containing the office chair. The agent requested explicit confirmation before any order-changing action. When the user hesitated, no action was taken. Upon the user’s request to exchange, the agent clearly stated the exact change and payment details, obtained explicit confirmation, executed the exchange via the tool, and accurately reported the tool’s result. All actions were on the authenticated user’s account, with no unsupported claims or unauthorized writes.
